LingoLooper (https://lingolooper.com) | Lead Content Strategist | REMOTE (Europe-friendly) | Part-time → Full-time

LingoLooper is a language learning game (1.4M+ downloads, iOS/Android) where users practice real conversations with AI avatars. Play life abroad to learn a language faster.

We've grown almost entirely through organic short-form content. We're hiring a Lead Content Strategist to own our content operation: directing UGC creators, analyzing performance data to build repeatable formats, running structured experiments, and building the systems that scale output. Think content strategy as engineering; hypothesis-driven, iterative, data-informed.

Starts ~30h/week ($750/week + performance bonuses), designed to convert to full-time with exit participation. You'll work directly with the founders.

Apply here: https://tally.so/r/GxJvAQ
